t: Titan TTB1335RSP 850W reciprocating saw delivers reliable cutting power for wood, metal and plastic. The versatile corded single pendulum saw is designed for demolition work, renovation projects and general-purpose site trimming. Variable speed control ensures clean, precise cuts across different materials, while a tool-free blade change system allows quick, easy replacement. Equipped with a lock-on switch and soft-grip handle for reduced user fatigue during extended operation, and an adjustable pivot shoe for enhanced stability. Supplied with a wood blade, metal blade and hex key.
